title: Blurry Lines
text:
Blurry Lines. The lines are blurry, almost pixelated like when you blow up a low quality image on the computer. Colors are not the best either. I was expecting way better.

EDIT: The company made it right by refunding half of the price and letting me keep the item. They were quick to respond and apologize. Much appreciated on their customer support.
